brief: Database column spec: Column (snake_case) / Type (like VARCHAR(255), TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) / Nullable / Default / Comment
title: Database column specification for orders table
html:
ColumnTypeNullableDefaultComment
order_idBIGINT UNSIGNEDNO—Primary key; auto-increment sequence shared across all sales channels
customer_idBIGINT UNSIGNEDNO—References customers.id; indexed for order history lookups
order_referenceVARCHAR(32)NO—Human-readable code shown to customers and on invoices, e.g. ORD-2024-008731
statusVARCHAR(24)NO'pending'One of pending, paid, fulfilled, cancelled, refunded; enforced by CHECK constraint
total_amount_centsINTEGERNO0Order total in minor currency units; never store floating-point money here
currency_codeCHAR(3)NO'USD'ISO 4217 alphabetic code; must match the currency of all line items
placed_atTIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONENOCURRENT_TIMESTAMPMoment the order was submitted; stored in UTC regardless of storefront locale
cancelled_atTIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONEYESNULLSet when status transitions to cancelled or refunded; NULL for active orders
